findings.title: Pinned-section floor ignores child's slug filter
findings.problem: hasPinnedContent is computed from raw helpAssistants.length, but NavigationPinnedSection only renders items whose slug matches ONBOARDING_ASSISTANT_SLUG or CHATBOT_ASSISTANT_SLUG.
findings.impact: If helpAssistants ever contains an entry matching neither slug, the parent reserves the 54px floor while the child renders nothing, wasting space in exactly the tight-viewport case this ticket targets; the inverse (zero reserved height while content exists) is also possible.
findings.recommendation: Derive hasPinnedContent from the same filtered allItems/staticItems list NavigationPinnedSection computes (or lift that derived list into assistantsStore) instead of raw helpAssistants.length.

findings.title: Profile popup detaches on header scroll
findings.problem: The OverlayPanel reposition effect only re-shows the panel on window resize; it has no listener for scroll of the header, which this change made scrollable (overflow-y-auto).
findings.impact: Scrolling the sidebar while the Profile overlay is open leaves it visually detached from its trigger button, directly failing the ticket's own acceptance criterion that menu items remain selectable and visually usable while the sidebar is scrolled.
findings.recommendation: Add a scroll listener on the header (e.g. header.addEventListener('scroll', handleResize, true)) alongside the existing window resize listener.

finding_status.notes: Navigation.tsx:96-99 computes staticHelpAssistantsCount by filtering on ONBOARDING_ASSISTANT_SLUG/CHATBOT_ASSISTANT_SLUG, mirroring NavigationPinnedSection.tsx's staticItems find() logic exactly; passed into hasPinnedSectionContent in place of raw helpAssistants.length. New test covers the zero-match case.
